TABLE.NAME: availability_password_grant
TABLE.COMMENT: Information about all users who have correctly entered the password for a given activity.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the course where the password was entered.

FIELD.NAME: cmid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the course module for which the password was entered.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The ID of the user who has entered the password.

FIELD.NAME: passwordhash
FIELD.COMMENT: The SHA-256 hash of the password that was entered, salted with the cmid.
